title: Between
prompt: Return true if n is between low and high, including both ends. is_between(5, 1, 10) is true; is_between(11, 1, 10) is false.
starter:
func is_between(n, low, high):
	return false
hints: Two comparisons have to hold at the same time.
The word for that is and.

docs.what: Comparisons. Each gives true or false.

docs.name: and  or  not
docs.what: and is true when both sides are; or when at least one is; not flips true and false.

solution:
func is_between(n, low, high):
	return n >= low and n <= high
